title.sl: I had it mended, it is said · Dati kaj narediti in trpnik
title.de: I had it mended, it is said · Etwas machen lassen und Passiv
title.it: I had it mended, it is said · Farsi fare qualcosa e passivo
title.en: I had it mended, it is said · Having things done and the passive

description.sl: Kar naredi drug zate: I had my hair cut, we're having the roof repaired, v pogovoru get it done. Trpnik v vseh časih: it has been repaired, it's being mended. Kar ljudje pravijo: it is said that, he is said to be.
description.de: Was ein anderer für dich tut: I had my hair cut, we're having the roof repaired, gesprochen get it done. Das Passiv in jeder Zeit: it has been repaired, it's being mended. Was man sagt: it is said that, he is said to be.
description.it: Ciò che un altro fa per te: I had my hair cut, we're having the roof repaired, a voce get it done. Il passivo in ogni tempo: it has been repaired, it's being mended. Ciò che si dice: it is said that, he is said to be.
description.en: What someone else does for you: I had my hair cut, we're having the roof repaired, in talk get it done. The passive in every tense: it has been repaired, it's being mended. What people say: it is said that, he is said to be.

review: en, sl, de, it: machine-written (Claude), not reviewed by a native speaker

story.sl: Mr Dixon has a long list today. Everyone in the dale wants something mended. · Mr Dixon ima danes dolg seznam. Vsak v dolini bi rad dal kaj popraviti.
story.de: Mr Dixon has a long list today. Everyone in the dale wants something mended. · Mr Dixon hat heute eine lange Liste. Jeder im Tal will etwas reparieren lassen.
story.it: Mr Dixon has a long list today. Everyone in the dale wants something mended. · Oggi Mr Dixon ha una lunga lista. Tutti nella valle vogliono farsi riparare qualcosa.
story.en: Mr Dixon has a long list today. Everyone in the dale wants something mended.

instruction.sl: Pick the right form · Izberi pravilno obliko
instruction.de: Pick the right form · Wähle die richtige Form
instruction.it: Pick the right form · Scegli la forma giusta

exercises.prompt: I didn't cut it myself: I ___ at the barber's in Keswick.

explain.sl:
**Kar naredi drug zate: have + stvar + deležnik**
- **I had my hair cut.** · Ostrigli so me.
- **I had cut my hair.** · {m:Sam|f:Sama} sem se že prej {m:ostrigel|f:ostrigla}.
explain.de:
**Was ein anderer für dich tut: have + Sache + Partizip**
- **I had my hair cut.** · Ich habe mir die Haare schneiden lassen.
- **I had cut my hair.** · Ich hatte mir die Haare selbst geschnitten.
explain.it:
**Ciò che un altro fa per te: have + cosa + participio**
- **I had my hair cut.** · Mi sono fatt{m:o|f:a} tagliare i capelli.
- **I had cut my hair.** · Mi ero tagliat{m:o|f:a} i capelli da sol{m:o|f:a}.
explain.en:
**Someone else does it for you: have + the thing + the participle**
- **I had my hair cut.**
- **I had cut my hair.** (myself, earlier)

instruction.sl: Pick the right word · Izberi pravo besedo
instruction.de: Pick the right word · Wähle das richtige Wort
instruction.it: Pick the right word · Scegli la parola giusta

exercises.prompt: We're ___ the roof repaired next week.

explain.sl:
**Spremeni se le have: we're having, we've had, we'll have + stvar + deležnik**
- **We're having the roof repaired.** · Prihodnji teden nam bodo popravili streho.
explain.de:
**Nur have ändert sich: we're having, we've had, we'll have + Sache + Partizip**
- **We're having the roof repaired.** · Wir lassen das Dach reparieren.
explain.it:
**Cambia solo have: we're having, we've had, we'll have + cosa + participio**
- **We're having the roof repaired.** · Facciamo riparare il tetto.
explain.en:
**Only have changes: we're having, we've had, we'll have + the thing + the participle**
- **We're having the roof repaired.**

instruction.sl: Pick the right form · Izberi pravilno obliko
instruction.de: Pick the right form · Wähle die richtige Form
instruction.it: Pick the right form · Scegli la forma giusta

exercises.prompt: Old Wilf ___ to have seen a ghost on the fell.

explain.sl:
**Kar ljudje pravijo: osebek + is said to + osnovna oblika, za preteklost to have + deležnik**
- **Wilf is said to have seen a ghost.** · Pravijo, da je Wilf videl duha.
explain.de:
**Was man sagt: Subjekt + is said to + Grundform, für Vergangenes to have + Partizip**
- **Wilf is said to have seen a ghost.** · Wilf soll einen Geist gesehen haben.
explain.it:
**Ciò che si dice: soggetto + is said to + forma base, per il passato to have + participio**
- **Wilf is said to have seen a ghost.** · Si dice che Wilf abbia visto un fantasma.
explain.en:
**What people say: the subject + is said to + the base form, for the past to have + the participle**
- **Wilf is said to have seen a ghost.**

instruction.sl: Which are right? · Katere so pravilne?
instruction.de: Which are right? · Welche sind richtig?
instruction.it: Which are right? · Quali sono giuste?

options: Old Wilf had his wallet stolen.

explain.sl:
**have ali get + stvar + deležnik; tudi za kaj slabega, kar se ti zgodi**
- **I got my van fixed.** · Popravili so mi kombi.
- **He had his wallet stolen.** · Ukradli so mu denarnico.
explain.de:
**have oder get + Sache + Partizip; auch für Schlimmes, das dir passiert**
- **I got my van fixed.** · Ich habe den Lieferwagen reparieren lassen.
- **He had his wallet stolen.** · Ihm wurde die Brieftasche gestohlen.
explain.it:
**have o get + cosa + participio; anche per qualcosa di brutto che ti capita**
- **I got my van fixed.** · Ho fatto riparare il furgone.
- **He had his wallet stolen.** · Gli hanno rubato il portafoglio.
explain.en:
**have or get + the thing + the participle; also for something bad that happens to you**
- **I got my van fixed.**
- **He had his wallet stolen.**

**Že narejeno: has, have + been + deležnik**

explain.de:
**Schon erledigt: has, have + been + Partizip**
- **The bridge has been repaired.** · Die Brücke ist repariert worden.
explain.it:
**Già fatto: has, have + been + participio**
- **The bridge has been repaired.** · Il ponte è stato riparato.
explain.en:
**Already done: has, have + been + the participle**
- **The bridge has been repaired.**

explain.sl:
**Osebek + is said to: pravijo, da …**

- **Wilf is said to know every fell.** · Pravijo, da Wilf pozna vsak hrib.

**Subjekt + is said to: man sagt, dass …**
- **The tarn is said to have no bottom.** · Der Bergsee soll keinen Grund haben.
- **Wilf is said to know every fell.** · Wilf soll jeden Berg kennen.
explain.it:
**Soggetto + is said to: si dice che …**
- **The tarn is said to have no bottom.** · Si dice che il laghetto non abbia fondo.
- **Wilf is said to know every fell.** · Si dice che Wilf conosca ogni monte.
explain.en:
**The subject + is said to: people say that …**
- **The tarn is said to have no bottom.**
- **Wilf is said to know every fell.**
